title: Odd part of a cube function
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, its odd part is the function $x\\mapsto (f(x)-f(-x))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n specifying the dimension of the sign cube
A real-valued function on that cube
